spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Praised, commended.
E.
णु to praise, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Sent, ordered, despatched.
m. (-त्तः)
A plant: see लकुच.
E.
णुद to send, aff. क्त; also नुन्न.

Praised, eulogized, hymned.
E.
णु to praise, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 Praise, eulogium, panegyrick.
2 Worship, reverence.
E.
णु to praise, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
New, recent, fresh, young, &c.
E.
नव new, नू substituted for it, and तनप् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Newness, novelty.
E.
त्व added to the last; also with तल्, नूतनता.

mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं)
New.
E.
नू substituted for नव new, त्नप् aff.
